title: The Mississippi River
text: The Mississippi River is the second-longest river in North America, flowing approximately 3,730 km from its source at Lake Itasca in northern Minnesota to its mouth in the Gulf of Mexico near New Orleans, Louisiana. Together with its tributaries, the Mississippi-Missouri river system is one of the world's longest, extending over 6,270 km. The river drains 3.2 million square kilometers — about 40% of the contiguous United States. It has been a critical transportation and trade artery throughout American history. Major cities along its banks include Minneapolis, St. Louis, Memphis, and New Orleans. The river is subject to periodic flooding; the Great Mississippi Flood of 1927 was one of the most destructive in U.S. history.
